feed.title: Windhawk Mod Updates
feed.subtitle: Updates in the official collection of Windhawk mods

entry.title: No-Click Touchpad: Tap & Hold 1.1
entry.content:
• Added a "Taps to right-click" setting. With two taps, a single tap in the corner does nothing and a quick double tap right-clicks.
  • "Two taps, one tap left-clicks" works the same, but a single corner tap left-clicks about half a second later.

entry.title: Touchpad Relaxed Hand Tracking 1.2.1
entry.content:
• Steadier speed multiplier (improved "flicks"): the higher multiplier no longer drops at the start and end of each movement, when fingers don't move in unison (most noticeable with five fingers down). The lower multiplier now only takes over after a confirmed movement with fewer fingers.
  • No more accidental clicks with five fingers resting: touchpads usually report up to five contacts, and a thumb split in two at the pad's edge made the pad take turns among them; those swaps no longer click.
  • 5-3 fingers moving default speed Increased to 2.0 after this update's precision gain.
  • Readme and settings review.

entry.title: Nimbus Menu 2.0.0
entry.content:
• Tray: the icons of the apps running in the background, next to the status area. Inline with arrows, behind one button (pin the ones you want outside), or in a grid or list panel. Clicks go to the app itself; the middle button pins; drag an icon onto another to reorder.
  • Control center: one dock button opens do not disturb, Bluetooth, night light, shortcuts (project, cast, captions, accessibility), each monitor's brightness (DDC/CI), sound, power and any other item placed there. Each item opens its full panel inside it, and it scrolls on small screens.
  • Every status item can be in the dock, the control center and Start at once, or off.
  • Bluetooth: turn it on and off, paired devices with their battery, connect and disconnect headsets and speakers.
  • Notifications: Windows' notifications also show as Nimbus cards (corner of your choice, paused under the mouse, never over games), with their buttons; a bell opens the list, newest first; Win+N can open it. Optional: hide Windows' own banners (asks first, restored when turned off). Its own sounds (15 to pick, or Windows' own), one for notifications and one for reminders.
  • Player: what any app plays in Windows' media controls: cover, title, time, controls, shuffle and repeat, that app's volume, switch between apps. In the dock as the cover and title, the cover, the title, bars moving with the sound, or an icon.
  • Devices: wireless batteries (Bluetooth, Xbox controllers, and USB receivers through BatteryHub when installed), with warnings at 20% and 10%.
  • Notes and reminders: notes stay until deleted; reminders come as Nimbus notifications, late too if the PC was off.
  • Shelf: drop files on the dock to keep them for a moment, then drag them anywhere; Ctrl+V turns a copied picture or text into a file.
  • Start: smarter search (no accents needed, initials like "vsc", one typo, common nicknames, what you open most first), keyboard navigation in every tab, power buttons that ask before restart or shut down, and a right-click menu with sign out, hibernate and restart to advanced options. All apps refreshes when an app is installed or removed.
  • Power modes follow Windows' power plans (High performance, Balanced, Power saver).
  • Its own settings window with a live preview; Windhawk's settings tab is empty on purpose (1.x settings carry over). A guided setup asks a few questions on the first run.
  • Follows Windows' high contrast and "Animation effects" off.
  • Start's Status tab in the control center's look (time, player, round switches, sliders, tray, power, rows), its parts in any order ("Organize": drag them, or Alt + arrows), saved per account.
  • Sound panel, simple (the default, as before) or complete (Settings › Status area › Sound): the apps playing on the left and every output on the right. Drag an app onto an output to play it there too, from one output to another to move it, × to take it off one; choose the default output and the one for calls. Complete is off by default because it changes Windows' sound output: the default and communications outputs (IPolicyConfig) and each app's output (the AudioPolicyConfig factory Windows' own Sound settings use), both undocumented by Microsoft; an app on a second output is a copy Nimbus plays through process loopback (documented, Windows 10 2004+) while it runs. An app that picks its own outputs (TeamSpeak, Discord) is muted on the one it's taken off. Going back to Simple puts everything back (every app on the default, copies off, those mutes undone). Listed in the readme's "What it changes in Windows".
  • Notification sounds stay audible during calls (Nimbus' audio session opts out of Windows' communications ducking).
  • Many fixes: dock clicks on admin windows, panels anchored to their item, faster panels (slow reads moved to worker threads).

entry.title: Explorer Tabs Session Saver Revamped 1.0.0
entry.content:
Explorer Tabs Session Saver Revamped

This mod saves your open File Explorer tabs and automatically restores them whenever you reopen File Explorer.

It is an enhanced successor to Explorer Tabs Session Saver by noX1st, fixing several core issues and edge cases.

Improvements Over the Original Mod

  • No Extra "Blank" Tab on Restore: When File Explorer opens to a default start location (Home or This PC), the initial left-most tab is navigated in-place (IWebBrowser2::Navigate / IShellBrowser::BrowseObject) instead of spawning a separate ShellExecuteExW call for the first saved tab. If Explorer is opened for a specific folder (e.g. "Show in folder" or a folder shortcut), that folder and its selection are preserved and your saved tabs open alongside it.
  • Fixes Sidebar Auto-Scrolling to the Bottom: Prevents File Explorer's Navigation Pane (SysTreeView32) from jumping or flickering to the bottom when restoring tabs with Explorer Tab Utility.
  • Persistent Session Protection: Opening File Explorer and closing it immediately without interacting with the restored tabs will no longer delete or lose your saved session.
  • Atomic Multi-Tab Window Close: Ignores tabs belonging to a top-level Explorer window that is already in the middle of closing, preventing partial tab lists from overwriting your session when closing a multi-tab window.
  • Per-User UTF-8 Session Storage: Stores sessions per Windows user account (LastExplorerTabs-<SID>.txt) in UTF-8 so folder paths with accented or Unicode characters are preserved and multi-user accounts do not collide.
  • Clean Mod Reload / Unload: Joins worker threads and unsubclasses controls deterministically on unload.

Notes

  • Works independently of the built-in Windows feature "Restore previous folder windows at logon".
  • Important: To restore tabs into a single File Explorer window, Explorer Tab Utility (with its "Window Hook" feature enabled) or a similar tab-merging utility is required. Otherwise, each tab will be restored in its own separate window.

entry.title: Explorer Translucent Menus 1.3.2
entry.content:
• Match menu captions and symbols to the explicit Light or Dark palette, including Shell captions drawn in separate buffers.
  • Apply the shared tooltip material to truncated navigation labels.
  • Group material and hover settings. This will reset the custom values in settings.

entry.title: Charging Animation 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Introduce Aurora Ribbons, Hex Grid Pulse, Energy Fill, Particle Sparks, and Radar Sweep effects
  • Expand total effect count from six to eleven with detailed effect behaviors and parameters
  • Add new card styles: Capsule (Gradient), Halo Dial (Segments), Dot Matrix (Mono), Half Gauge (Arc), Ticker Strip (Marquee)
  • Update animation parameters to apply to new effects including Strength, Duration, Motion, and Opacity
  • Enhance unplug direction support for additional effects with detailed control
  • Modify rendering logic to support new effects with optimized frame rates for performance
  • Improve visual and interaction details for cards and animations, including dynamic coloring and positioning options
  • Refactor code for effect initialization, rendering, and resource management to accommodate new effects

entry.title: Win+V Panel Tweaks 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Adds a "Pinned" button next to "Clear all" that shows only your pinned clipboard items. Click it again to show everything. "Clear all" is hidden while only pinned items are shown.
  • Adds a Win+Alt+V shortcut that opens the panel showing only pinned items.
  • The button and the shortcut can be turned off or changed in the new "Pinned items" settings group.
  • The shortcut runs in a small separate Windhawk process.

entry.title: Window Centralizer 1.3.0
entry.content:
• New option, Always center child windows (on by default), replacing the special case for standard dialogs: windows that belong to another (Save As, Properties, an app's settings) are centered whatever their size, while windows without an owner, such as a program's main window, follow the size limit. Dialogs of Windows itself without an owner, such as Run or Sound, count as child windows of the system; other programs dialogs opened alone, without an owner, follow the limit.
  • Default hotkeys changed to Win+Shift+I (ignore) and Win+Ctrl+Shift+I (ignored list).
  • Size limit default changed from 10 to 20%.
  • Parent mode center on the unrelated window enabled by default.
  • README and settings reviewed and reorganized.

entry.title: ClassicWindowSwitcher 1.4
entry.content:
• Performance improvements that prevent the switcher window from lagging on Alt+Tab/Tilde press
    • Offload app icon loading to a background thread
    • Fetch application names only once per dialog show
  • Fix grouped window counting not working well with some windows

entry.title: 1 Letter Language Indicator 1.1
entry.content:
• New Letter weight setting: font weight of the letter from 1 to 999 (100 Thin … 900 Black). 0 keeps the Windows weight (400).
  • Overrides TextBlock.FontWeight on InnerTextBlock with the same property-callback mechanism as the other settings, and restores the original weight on unload or when set back to 0.
  • Fixed: the indicator went back to the full text after switching the taskbar size between small and default.

entry.title: Background Dimmer 1.2.0
entry.content:
• Per-monitor dimming: configuration window lists the connected monitors under Active; unchecked ones stay always lit.
  • Improved menu vs dialog detection: new logic based of title bars. Windows with a title bar are treated as dialogs; small windows without one, like Office menus or Chrome extension panels, are treated as menus.
  • Fade: the window that loses focus dims gradually, including when a dialog opens or Alt+Tab, Start, the taskbar or the desktop takes focus.
  • Taskbar dimming (off by default): a click-through layer over each taskbar, hidden while the taskbar, Start or Alt+Tab has focus.
  • Image / Custom pattern replaces Image: a Scale setting (1–400%) takes the place of Size, and brightness, contrast and base color apply to the image like they do to the other patterns.
  • Tray icon click-action swap: click toggles dimming, right-click opens the configuration window.
  • New default configuration hotkey: Win+Ctrl+Shift+D, to match with possible Win+Shift+D on/off toggle shortcut.

entry.content:

entry.title: Modern Run Dialog UI For Windows 10 & 11 6.0.1.0
entry.content:
• Dedicated WinUI 3 Settings App (Hosted in windhawk.exe): Replaced the in-process settings popup with a standalone Windows 11 Settings–style window hosted in windhawk.exe -tool-mod (zero overlap with the Run dialog), featuring Direct2D SettingsExpander cards, ComboBox flyouts, and a 2D Hue-Saturation ColorPicker with 16 Fluent swatches.
  • 13 Built-In Themes & Full Visual Customization (#7693): Switched the default theme to Windows 11 Blur (frosted Fluent Acrylic, 14px corners, hairline border) for clean readability, while keeping Liquid Glass and adding 11 new presets (Windows 11 Mica, Fluent Solid, Classic Win11, Midnight OLED, Nord Frost, Catppuccin Mocha, Dracula Velvet, Rosé Pine, Emerald Slate, Warm Paper, and Custom). Added custom Background Color, Border Color, Corner Radius (0–28 px), Dialog Position (Auto, Corners, Edges, or Screen Center), and Custom Static Image / Animated GIF Background support (up to 25 MB, auto-scaled, adjustable opacity).
  • Classic-Friendly Default & Optional Compact Mini-Pill (360px): Enabled Classic-Friendly Mode by default to preserve Win + R → Enter muscle memory (pre-filled last command, full Browse/Run/Exit/Settings buttons, and 20-item history), with a one-click toggle to switch to Compact Mini-Pill Mode (360px).
  • Task Manager Support, Pinning, Aliases & Safe Elevation: Extended the modern UI to Task Manager → "Run new task" (Taskmgr.exe) while respecting Task Manager's own elevation checkbox (including for google: and Shift + Enter terminal launches). Added Pinned Commands, Custom Command Aliases (e.g., hosts), Ctrl + Shift + Enter one-time Administrator elevation, Shift + Enter terminal execution, and Remember Last Window Position (#7612).
  • Visual & Z-Order Bug Fixes (#7600): Fixed the black bar glitch when opening/closing via Win + R (DWM cloak/transition handling) and resolved taskbar overlap via taskbar-aware work-area clamping.
  • Streamlined UX, Security & Stability Improvements: Added percentage (%) support to the instant calculator, capped stored history at 20 items for lower memory usage, removed the built-in Google Translate (文A) mode to keep the launcher focused, removed -ExecutionPolicy Bypass for elevated .ps1 execution, dropped shared #32770 class icon overrides, and hardened uninit/cleanup paths.
